items.title: Every game now has real cover art
items.body: Each title in the library is captured live from its own running build, so the cards show actual gameplay instead of placeholder icons. Ten new titles joined this round: Word Weaver, Minefield Classic, Snake Reactor, Tetro Stack, Flappy Ascent, Neon Breakout, Boids Sanctuary, Ant Colony, Sudoku Master and Solitaire Suite.

items.title: Library-wide repair pass
items.body: Every registered game was read end to end and independently re-checked. Broken controls, unreachable win states, achievements that showed as blank, save/resume gaps and one game still loading code from the internet were all fixed. The library is fully offline again.

items.title: 45 games and growing
items.body: Twenty combat, sports, adventure and story games plus twelve strategy and simulation titles joined the original library. Sort by genre or newest, or use Surprise Me to jump directly into a game.

items.title: Quality gate online
items.body: Every registered game now passes automated manifest, asset, entry, syntax and placeholder checks before it can ship inside RVKKO OS.

items.title: Hub foundation online
items.body: The Empire hub is live: library, saves, achievements, profile, settings, full keyboard/mouse/gamepad navigation, and the Empire SDK for all future games.

items.title: Flagship #1 launched: Procedural Dungeon RPG
items.body: The first flagship is live with procedural dungeons, loot, combat and floor bosses.

items.title: The road to 80+ games
items.body: The catalog plan is now 80–100 complete offline titles with distinct gameplay loops. Nothing fake and nothing half-built appears in the live library.
